description:
Creates a new job application entry in GigHQ, or reuses an existing active one for the same company+job if the backend finds one — check `alreadyExist` in the response. Calling find_job_application first is still recommended when you want to inspect a possible match before deciding.

New applications always start in PROSPECTING status — there is no way to create directly into APPLIED/INTERVIEWING/etc. If the user has already applied, call update_job_application_status with status "APPLIED" right after this returns.

Optionally pass `source_url` and/or `job_description` to save them in the same call — attached best-effort after the application is created/found. If that secondary save fails, the create/find itself still succeeds and a warning is included in the response instead of an error.
When an existing application is reused, supplied posting details can replace its saved source URL or job description.

company.description: The name of the company you applied to.

job.description: The job title or role you applied for.

job_description.description: The full job description text, if known. Saved best-effort after create/find.

source_url.description: The URL of the job posting, if known. Saved best-effort after create/find.

name: create_job_application
